run_visualize_waymo_map: run the script to parse a Waymo protobuf text file and plot map features as a PNG image
run_visualize_waymo_map_animation: run the script with show_tracks enabled to generate an MP4 animation of object tracks over 20 timesteps
parse_waymo_protobuf_text: parse a Waymo Open Dataset protobuf text representation from output.txt into a nested Python dictionary
plot_waymo_map_features: plot lane centerlines, road lines, road edges, stop signs, crosswalks, and speed bumps from parsed map feature data
save_waymo_map_visualization: save the Waymo map visualization as a PNG file and optionally an MP4 animation of tracked objects
